keysForm.apiKeyVertexOnly: (Supported only for gemini and fine-tuned models)
keysForm.assumeRoleDesc: Assume an IAM role before requests. Works with both explicit credentials and inherited IAM (EC2, ECS, EKS).
keysForm.azureDefaultCredentialDescription: Uses DefaultAzureCredential - automatically detects managed identity on Azure VMs and containers, workload identity in AKS, environment variables, and Azure CLI. No credentials required.
keysForm.batchRoleArnDesc: Service role Bedrock assumes for batch S3 access. When set, it takes priority over the role_arn sent in requests.
keysForm.bedrockProjectIdDesc: Scopes inference and model listing to a specific Bedrock project (sent as the OpenAI-Project / anthropic-workspace-id header). Leave empty to use the account's default project.
keysForm.clientIdPlaceholder: Service principal client ID or env.DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID
keysForm.copilotCredentialMiddle2: is the option for a shared gateway: usage bills to the organization that owns the installation and no individual Copilot seat is used. A
keysForm.copilotCredentialMiddle3: in the field above is simpler but expires after about 30 minutes, so it suits testing rather than a running gateway.
keysForm.copilotCredentialPrefix: Copilot accepts either credential. Fill in
keysForm.copilotTokenDescription: Requires Network Config > Base URL set to the host the token was issued for, because a Copilot token does not carry one. Also expires after about 30 minutes, and Bifrost cannot refresh a token it did not mint, so prefer the GitHub App below for anything long-running.
keysForm.copilotTokenPlaceholder: Copilot API token, or leave blank to use a GitHub App
keysForm.credentialsStored: Credentials are stored securely. Edit to update.
keysForm.deploymentsDescription: Map a request model name to the provider's identifier (deployment name, inference profile ID, etc.). Expand a row for canonical name, model family, and provider overrides - these drive cost logs and family-based routing.
keysForm.deploymentsEndpointDescTail: , so plain model names stop working. To switch just one model, leave this off and set "Use deployments endpoint" on its row above.
keysForm.externalIdDesc: Required by the role's trust policy when using cross-account access
keysForm.externalIdDescPeriod: Required by the role's trust policy when using cross-account access.
keysForm.forceSingleRegionDesc: Always call the region set above and skip automatic promotion of multi-region-only models to a multi-region endpoint. Enable when serving these models from a single region via provisioned throughput.
keysForm.forwardGovernanceTagsDesc: Sends the virtual key, team and customer names as Databricks-Ai-Gateway-Request-Tags, so Databricks usage tracking attributes spend the same way Bifrost does. Names only, never user identifiers.
keysForm.githubAppCredentialsDesc: Leave these blank if you supplied a Copilot API token above. Otherwise all four are needed together. The App needs the Copilot Requests permission at Read & write, installed on the organization that should be billed with All repositories access, and that organization must allow Copilot requests from GitHub App installations.
keysForm.inferenceSurfaceDesc: Auto picks by model name: a dotted name such as system.ai.claude-sonnet-4-5 goes to the Unity AI Gateway, anything else to Model Serving. Choose explicitly to pin one surface.
keysForm.mantleProjectIdDesc: Scopes Bedrock Mantle-routed models (OpenAI-family / Gemma) to a specific project via the OpenAI-Project header. Leave empty to use the account's default project.
keysForm.name: Name
keysForm.oauthM2mDesc: Databricks recommends OAuth machine-to-machine for production. Tokens are minted from the workspace OIDC endpoint and refreshed automatically.
keysForm.patDesc: Generate one from Settings > Developer > Access tokens in your workspace.
keysForm.privateKeyDesc: The App's private key in PEM form, as downloaded from GitHub. PKCS#1 and PKCS#8 both work.
keysForm.projectNumberFineTuned: Project Number (Required only for fine-tuned models)
keysForm.regionMultiRegionPrefix: Multi-region-only models are automatically routed to Google's matching multi-region endpoint. Turn on
keysForm.regionMultiRegionSuffix: below to always use exactly this region.
keysForm.repositoryIdDesc: Any repository the installation can access. Copilot's permission check requires one in the token request even though the installation itself needs All repositories access, so this is not really a scoping choice.
keysForm.scopesTooltip: Optional OAuth scopes for token requests. By default we use https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default - add additional scopes here if your setup requires extra permissions.
keysForm.serverUrlDesc: Base URL of the vLLM server (e.g. http://vllm-server:8000 or env.VLLM_URL)
keysForm.serviceAccountJsonDesc: Service account JSON object or env.VAR_NAME
keysForm.setUpGithubAppLink: Set up a GitHub App for Copilot
keysForm.useAnthropicEndpointsDesc: Routes chat completions and responses requests through Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
keysForm.useForBatchApisDescription: Enable this key for batch API operations. Only keys with this enabled will be used for batch requests.
keysForm.useOpenAIEndpointsDesc: Routes requests through Bedrock's OpenAI-compatible endpoints instead of Converse.
keysForm.usesBearerToken: Uses a Bearer token for API key authentication.
keysForm.usesBedrockMantleToken: Uses a Bedrock Mantle API key sent as a Bearer token.
keysForm.usesIamRoles: Uses IAM roles attached to your environment (EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS).
keysForm.vertexServiceAccountNote: Uses the service account attached to your environment (GCE, GKE, Cloud Run). No credentials required.
keysForm.vllmModelNameDesc: Exact model name served on this vLLM instance
keysForm.vpcEndpointcontrolplaneDescription: Serves model listing and batch jobs.
keysForm.vpcEndpoints3Description: Serves batch file I/O. Requires the bucket-prefixed endpoint name. A Gateway endpoint needs no value here.
keysForm.vpcEndpointsDescription: Route traffic through interface VPC endpoints instead of the public regional endpoints. Use each endpoint's DNS name from the VPC console, not its ID. Region is still required — it sets the request signing scope.
keysForm.weightTooltip: Determines traffic distribution between keys. Higher weights receive more requests. Not used when adaptive load balancing is enabled - key selection is then based on live performance.
keysForm.workspaceUrlDesc: Your Databricks workspace URL (e.g. https://dbc-1234abcd-5678.cloud.databricks.com or env.DATABRICKS_WORKSPACE_URL)
keysForm.allowedModelsTooltip: Select specific models this key applies to, or choose "Allow All Models" to allow all. Leave empty to deny all. Aliases must be added by their alias name - listing only the underlying model does not allow the alias (an alias best-model → gpt-4o requires "best-model" here, not just "gpt-4o").
keysForm.blockedModelsTooltip: Models this key must never serve. The denylist always wins - if a model appears in both Allowed Models and here, it is blocked. Select "All Models" to block every model on this key. Aliases are matched by their alias name - blocking only the underlying model does not block aliases that point to it.
keysForm.replicateDeploymentsHint: Replicate deployments are listed only while "Use Deployments Endpoint" is on - otherwise type the owner/name and press Enter.

promptCache.autoInjectDescription: Agentic clients such as Codex send no cache markers, so the cached prefix follows the newest message and every turn is billed as a cache write. Turning this on marks the first cacheable block instead, which keeps the cached region stable so turn 2 onward is a cache read. Requests that already carry their own cache markers are never modified, and models without explicit caching are left alone.
promptCache.injectionPointsDescription: Optional. Target specific messages instead of the first cacheable block. Adding any point
promptCache.injectionPointsDescriptionSuffix: the default strategy rather than adding to it. Each point needs a role, an index, or both. At most four markers are injected, matching the provider ceiling.
promptCache.pointValidationError: Each point needs a role, an index, or both.
promptCache.ttlDescription: A longer TTL costs more per cache write but survives gaps between turns. Providers that cannot carry a TTL ignore this.
